title: Black Friday 2026 UK live deals: the best offers right now
seoTitle: Black Friday Weekend & Cyber Monday 2026 UK: Live Deals
description: The best UK Black Friday weekend and Cyber Monday 2026 deals still live, checked every morning until 30 November: tech, home, beauty and toys, with prices compared.
intro:
**Last checked: Saturday 28 November, 09:53.** Black Friday has passed, but Amazon's Black Friday Week runs until Cyber Monday (30 November) and most of the best prices are still live. The three standouts right now: the **AirPods Pro 3 at £155.98** (a record low), the **Mac mini M6 at £692.70** (down another £44 overnight) and the **Amazon Ember 65-inch Mini-LED TV at £709.99** (£440 off), all at Amazon.

New this morning: the **Hisense 65-inch Canvas TV at £999**, a **4-pack of AirTags at £71.78**, the **Bowers & Wilkins PX7 S2e headphones at £208**, the **Galaxy Watch Ultra at £349** and **LEGO Star Wars Grogu at £67.49**, all at Amazon. We've taken off the Sonicare DiamondClean 9000, Bose QuietComfort Earbuds, Shokz OpenRun Pro 2, DualSense controller and Switch 2 bundle, as we couldn't re-confirm their prices for today (the Switch 2 Sports Resort bundle is £399.99 at Currys). **PS5 buyers:** see our [PS5 guide](/guides/ps5-black-friday-deals-2026/) for stock and bundles. Prices were reported on 27–28 November, so check the retailer's page before you buy. Many Amazon prices need Prime: a [free Prime trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) covers the rest of the sale. Today's shortlist is in [Saturday's deals](/deals/2026-11-28-saturday-deals/).

deals.name: Apple AirPods Pro 3

body:
## Tech

Apple: the AirPods Pro 3 are still a record-low £155.98 at Amazon, a 4-pack of AirTags is £71.78 and the Mac mini M6 has dropped again to £692.70. Apple's own Black Friday event (27–30 November) gives a gift card rather than a discount, so Amazon is cheaper. Amazon's own devices: the Kindle Colorsoft is £144.99, the basic Kindle £119.99, the Echo Dot £49.99, the Fire TV Stick 4K £31.99, the Ring Battery Video Doorbell 2K £39.99 and the Ring Pan-Tilt Indoor Camera 2K £29.99. For TVs, the Ember 65-inch Mini-LED is £709.99, the Hisense 65-inch Canvas £999 and the LG C6 65-inch OLED £1,529.10.

For audio, the Bowers & Wilkins PX7 S2e are £208 and the Sony WH-1000XM4C £161.10. The Galaxy Watch Ultra is £349 for Android users. Gamers: the Meta Quest 3S is £259.99, and the Switch 2 Sports Resort bundle is £399.99 at Currys.

More: [Kindle](/guides/kindle-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Echo](/guides/echo-dot-deals-uk/), [Ring doorbells](/guides/ring-doorbell-black-friday-deals-2026/), [AirPods](/guides/airpods-black-friday-deals-2026/), [TVs](/guides/tv-black-friday-deals-2026/), [smartwatches](/guides/smartwatch-deals-uk/), [PS5](/guides/ps5-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Switch 2](/guides/nintendo-switch-2-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Amazon Black Friday 2026](/guides/amazon-black-friday-2026-uk/).

## Home & kitchen

The Dyson V8 is £199.99 at Amazon, the cheapest way into a Dyson stick vacuum. In the kitchen, the Ninja AF300UK dual-drawer air fryer is £119, the Ninja Crispi glass air fryer £99, the De'Longhi Magnifica Evo bean-to-cup machine £379 and the Nespresso Vertuo Pop pod machine £49, all at Amazon. For robot vacuums, see our [robot vacuum guide](/guides/robot-vacuum-deals-uk/).

More: [air fryers](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Ninja](/guides/ninja-black-friday-deals-2026/), [coffee machines](/guides/coffee-machine-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Dyson](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Shark](/guides/shark-black-friday-deals-2026/).

## Beauty

The Philips ReAura LED face mask is £249.99 at Amazon, £100 off. For electric toothbrushes, see our [Oral-B guide](/guides/oral-b-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [compare Sonicare prices on Amazon](https://www.amazon.co.uk/s?k=Philips+Sonicare). For hair, see our [Dyson Airwrap price guide](/guides/dyson-airwrap-deals-uk/). For fragrance gifts, [compare Amazon's perfume gift set prices](https://www.amazon.co.uk/s?k=perfume+gift+set) before you buy.

More: [perfume gift sets](/guides/perfume-gift-sets-black-friday-2026/), [ghd](/guides/ghd-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Oral-B](/guides/oral-b-black-friday-deals-2026/).

## Toys & gifts

Advent calendars need to arrive by 1 December, so order those this weekend. LEGO Star Wars Grogu (75446) is £67.49 and the Lego Classic Large Creative Brick Box £28.99, both at Amazon. For readers, an [Audible membership](/guides/audible-free-trial-deals-uk/) is £0.99 a month for three months until 17 December and can be given as a gift. For toys, Hamleys is running its own Black Friday event, and our guide shows what's worth buying there.

More: [Hamleys Black Friday 2026](/guides/hamleys-black-friday-2026/), [Lego](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Lego advent calendars](/guides/lego-advent-calendar-2026/), [Nintendo Switch 2](/guides/nintendo-switch-2-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [PS5](/guides/ps5-black-friday-deals-2026/).

## How we pick these deals

Every price comes from the retailer or a trusted deals source dated today or yesterday. We compare it with price history and last year's Black Friday prices, and we leave out deals where the 'was' price is inflated. When Amazon matches the cheapest shop, we link Amazon. Many Amazon prices need Prime during Black Friday Week; our [Prime free trial guide](/guides/amazon-prime-free-trial-black-friday-2026/) explains how to time a trial.

### When is Black Friday 2026 in the UK?

It was on Friday 27 November, and the sales carry on to Cyber Monday, 30 November. Our [when is Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/) lists every retailer's dates.

### Are Black Friday deals still on this weekend?

Yes. Amazon's Black Friday Week runs until Cyber Monday, 30 November, and most of the prices on this page are still live. We check every deal each morning and take off any that have ended, so if it's listed here it was live when we last checked.

### When is Cyber Monday 2026?

Cyber Monday is **Monday 30 November 2026**, the last day of Amazon's Black Friday Week. We update this page every morning until then, so new Cyber Monday prices will show up here. More on the dates in our [when is Cyber Monday guide](/guides/when-is-cyber-monday-2026-uk/).

### Should I buy now or wait for Cyber Monday?

If a deal here is marked 'Lowest price', buy it: Cyber Monday prices are usually the same or slightly worse, and popular items sell out. Items marked 'Good price' could still dip a little by Monday.

### How often is this page updated?

Every day until Cyber Monday. Deals that end or go up in price are removed.

See [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/) for brand-by-brand prices.
